data.body: [orchestrator 2026-08-30] Already fixed on origin/main. The identical class-level fix landed under duplicate ticket 408c-9c78-c523-4d1c via commit f87719be9999 ('fix(autodeploy): add 2 sources to path manifests', Verified+1, merged): CONFIG_PATHS now enumerates infra/gerrit/materialize-deploy-key.sh (Instance 1, this ticket) and MCP_PATHS enumerates infra/scripts/mcp-entrypoint.sh (Instance 2, sibling 5d4c-a25b-b612-4aca, already closed). Both regression tests present and green on main (tests/scripts/test_autodeploy_signals_gerrit_config.py, test_autodeploy_mcp_bluegreen.py). No new change needed; closing as duplicate to avoid double-counting escaped-defect metrics.
